title: Derived etale direct image detects vanishing on a finite closed support
statement:
Let $h:W\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, let $i:V\hookrightarrow W$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and suppose that $f=h\circ i:V\to S$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $K\in D^b(W_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Suppose that $K$ has zero restriction to $W\setminus i(V)$; equivalently, each cohomology sheaf of $K$ has zero geometric stalk outside $i(V)$. With derived direct image as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], one has
$$Rh_*K=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad K=0.$$
More generally, $Rh_*$ reflects isomorphisms between bounded complexes whose cohomology is supported on $i(V)$.
